pricing_basis: First release is intended to be a small polished classic-style card microgame.
Existing repo hypothesis is $1.99-$2.99 one-time; $1.99 remains the initial launch test hypothesis.
Final price remains HUMAN_REVIEW/HUMAN_ACTION before release.

notes: Rules are being rebuilt from the family's long-played version captured directly from the product owner.
The preserved Python Casino-era implementation is reference material, not authoritative where it conflicts with the family rules contract.
Final commercial art, audio and fonts must be original or commercially licensed and registered before RC.
Browser-first or lightweight desktop release remains the zero-upfront-cost distribution hypothesis.
Final policy, payment route and fees require release-window refresh.

stages.name: Discovery Intake
evidence: Existing family card game selected as first Capture 11 product candidate and first card-game reference implementation.

stages.name: Hostile Market / Legal / Distribution Research
evidence: Original branding requirement established; zero-upfront-cost release lane identified.
stages.next_action: Refresh commercial lane after playable CPU build exists.

stages.name: Commercial / Attention Hypothesis
evidence: Positioning centers on fast two-player risk, stealing, burns, builds, final-board control and first-to-11 scoring rather than an educational math-game pitch.
stages.next_action: Validate hook with external playtesters after first playable.

stages.name: Rights / Provenance
blockers: Final shipped asset register does not yet exist.
stages.next_action: Register final art/audio/font provenance before RC.

stages.name: Specification Lock
evidence: Capture 11 Family Rules Contract v0.1 exists.
Scoring, dealer rotation, face-rank behavior, build examples, final-board sweep and 26-26 tie are encoded in tests.
blockers: Several rare/compound move cases remain explicitly unresolved in the rules contract.
stages.next_action: Resolve each remaining rule through concrete scenario tests before declaring spec lock.

stages.name: Story Capture Plan
evidence: Product history and family-play origin are captured for future About/marketing use without making unsupported claims.
stages.next_action: Capture playable milestones and real playtest reactions.

stages.name: Pricing / Unit Economics
stages.next_action: Re-evaluate $1.99 vs $2.99 after CPU and private-PvP scope is known.

stages.name: Production
evidence: Dedicated capture-11-rebuild-v0.1 branch created from reusable TypeScript/Vite microgame runtime.
Domain model, deck/deal flow, scoring, final sweep and core legality helpers committed.
blockers: Full turn reducer, legal move enumeration, CPU, playable UI and audio/presentation are incomplete.
stages.next_action: Complete authoritative turn/state engine before polishing presentation.

stages.name: Automated Verification
evidence: Capture 11 unit suites added under existing Vitest/CI infrastructure.
blockers: Current rebuild CI must complete green after latest commits.
Game-specific stress/property tests are not yet complete.
stages.next_action: Keep PR CI green while expanding the rules engine.

stages.name: Human QA
blockers: No complete CPU match is playable yet.
stages.next_action: Human QA begins after first complete CPU match path exists.

stages.name: Derivative Map
evidence: Potential marketing clips include large-build steals, burns, risky point-card plays and final-board sweeps.
stages.next_action: Capture real gameplay clips after visual build exists.

stages.name: Platform Packaging
stages.next_action: Prepare store package after CPU build and QA.

stages.name: Compliance Refresh
blockers: Final release policy refresh required within release window.
stages.next_action: Refresh applicable store policies before RC.

stages.name: Release Candidate Verification
blockers: Specification, production, provenance, QA, packaging and compliance gates are incomplete.
stages.next_action: Generate RC only after predecessor gates pass.

stages.name: Human Release Approval
stages.next_action: Human approves exact release candidate and price.

stages.name: Post-Deploy Verification
stages.next_action: Verify public build, purchase path, price and critical play path immediately after deployment.

stages.name: Live Learning
stages.next_action: Track plays, purchases, rematches, support and PvP demand after launch.
